sanskrit_verse: aviplutabrahmacaryo lakṣaṇyāṃ striyam udvahet / ananyapūrvikāṃ kāntām asapiṇḍāṃ yavīyasīm // YajñS_1.52
transliteration: avipluta-brahmacaryo lakṣaṇyāṁ striyam udvahet / ananya-pūrvikāṁ kāntām asapiṇḍāṁ yavīyasīm
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has maintained unbroken brahmacarya shall lawfully take a wife in svayaṃvara upon her reaching maturity, exclusively devoted to him, unrelated by blood within the sapinda degrees, and younger in age.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derived from sustained spiritual discipline (brahmacarya)
Causation through conscious selection and dharmic readiness
Restoration logic via lawful union aligned with dharma
Consciousness alignment through exclusive spousal devotion
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent.has_unbroken_brahmacarya == True AND female.is_of_age_for_lakṣaṇyā == True THEN marriage.is_permitted = True
IF spouse.has_prior_conjugal_history != None THEN marriage.is_permitted = False
IF parties.are_sapinda_related == True THEN marriage.is_permitted = False
IF male.age < female.age THEN marriage.is_permitted = False ELSE permitted IF all_other_dharma_conditions_met
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matrimonial disputes, the Supreme Court must recognize that lawful marriage arises only when both parties fulfill the capacity conditions outlined herein. The court's role is to verify alignment with these axiomatic criteria rather than impose punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that unbroken brahmacarya qualifies the male for svayaṃvara. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that maturity and prior-conjugal absence determine eligibility. Responsibility lies in fulfilling dharma, not in fear of penalty. Thus, justice restores lawful alignment without punitive consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Confirm observance of brahmacarya through witness testimony or śāstric certification
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Both parties affirm understanding and acceptance of dharmic marital roles
Capacity Restoration: If prior violations occurred, initiate prāyaścitta under Śiva-dṛṣṭi guidance before proceeding
Integrity Reintegration: Conduct ritual affirmation of mutual exclusivity and sapinda compliance
final_declaration: This ruling flows directly from Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam as Source-Authority. Dharma is hereby restored through lawful union. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
